meta.title: Vocabulary review
meta.description: Turns an uploaded worksheet image into a one-word-at-a-time review loop. The model extracts only the underlined English words and calls vocab_import; the plugin keeps the clean list, never the image. Plain article images work too: the model reads the passage, picks the words that are high-frequency in the target exam (examLevel, default CET-4; also gaokao/cet6/kaoyan), marks out-of-scope words :out, and calls vocab_import_article; the plugin refuses :out words, drops basic everyday words (the, is, school…), caps the batch at articleMaxWords, and lets the user review the picked list before the loop starts. The plugin owns ledger.json and settings.json, wrong-word error counts and re-asks, the 30m→3h→12h→2d→7d→30d spaced-repetition ladder, the compact QUEUE/DUE lines injected each turn, the configurable daily new/review/total/minutes quotas with the 今日已达上限 stop state, the once-per-day due reminder (sidebar badge, panel banner, optional browser notification), a conversation selector that routes every Q/A prompt to the selected non-archived session and persists it in settings.json, and a strong-pause Stop (agent.cancel + jobs/terminals/subagents cleanup, silent, no transcript message). Grades three ways: ✅ known, 🤔 half-known (keeps its ladder stage and returns at half the interval), ❌ unknown; every model ✅ is re-checked by the plugin against the stored meaning, a mismatch is scheduled as wrong, and an explicit 不知道/不知道-style answer is always wrong, so the model cannot be generous on the user's behalf. Adds a left-sidebar Vocabulary review panel with due count, a weak-word book (failed or half-known words, hardest first, with Known / Ask again / Remove and CSV export), queue, counters, Start/Stop/Pause, editable limits saved without a restart, Two ways to review on QQ: (1) the built-in QQ bot — enter your QQ 开放平台 AppID / AppSecret in the sidebar panel and this plugin talks to the QQ gateway itself, with no third-party plugin (inbound text and images work, so an image sent in QQ can import an underlined word list or an article's exam-high-frequency words); (2) the bridge to the third-party @hualiong/dsh-qq-bot plugin (text inbound only). Both push each question to QQ and grade the answers typed there, so the same ledger and schedule can be reviewed on either side. The review loop keeps asking while words are due and stops only when every due word is done or a daily limit is hit, in which case it reports the reason (idleReason) instead of going silent. The ledger is versioned: a ledger.json written by a newer plugin is moved to a .bak file and a clean state is used instead of being misread. Intervals are tuned by a per-word ease factor (right answers stretch them, wrong answers tighten them); the panel also shows a last-7-days trend, the last import summary and a collapsible diagnostics block, and the weak-word book exports CSV/JSON/Anki. Review runs in the selected chat session. Turn the plugin off to stop all injection, reminders and API routes; ledger.json and settings.json stay on disk.
